observedIn: production evimed-8cf957bd0892-1, account cdss-access: the 33 approved learned methods' counters (loaded 160, read 3, invoked 1), the ledger rows of the 51 runs in 30 days that carried method cards, and the tool calls of their persisted transcripts (counted, not read) -- live audit 2026-10-12 section 4.5
whyItIsWrong: Three of the four runs that opened a mounted method's file left it out of the ledger row. The run row's `methodsInvoked` held only the methods a delivered deliverable could be credited with, so a run that delegated nothing (the answer line, where `read` 3 came from), a root session that read a method while a child made the deliverable, and a child whose deliverable never reached a verdict were counted in the method's `read` and nowhere else. `methodsInvoked` is the list a later correction of the run's result is joined through, so the second axis of the harm test never saw those methods either. And nothing recorded how often a card was weighed and passed over, so the unused cards could not be told from the ones waiting for their kind of question.
fix: `methodsInvoked` names every approved method the run opened in any of its owned sessions under the digest it was carried as; an open credited to no deliverable is a `read`; `counts.carried` counts the runs a card was in front of a model that answered; a card carried 20 answered runs (OPEN_SCIENCE_LEARNING_UNUSED_RETIRE_LOADS) and never opened is stopped with that count as the reason (apps/server/src/methodObservations.mjs, packages/domain/src/methodGraph.mjs).

scenarios.name: the answer line: the model opens the card that applies, and nothing is delivered
scenarios.note: No delegation means no receipt, no mounted digest from a child and no verdict: the open is a `read`, and it is in the run's row under the digest the runtime reported it carried.

scenarios.name: the root session reads a method while a child makes the deliverable
scenarios.note: The deliverable is not credited with a method its own session never opened (the 2026-09-28 rule), and the run's row still says the method was opened.

scenarios.name: a child opens the method in a deliverable that never reached a verdict
scenarios.note: No verdict is no observation, and the open is still not lost.

scenarios.name: a card carried to a model that answered and not opened is passed over, not used
scenarios.note: A line count of the file is looking at it, not reading it; the load counts toward the stop for a card nobody opens.

liveCheck: After the release: a conversation on the answer line that opens a mounted method's SKILL.md (one real DSH + DeepSeek turn) -- its runs.jsonl `learning` row names the method in methodsInvoked, the method's counts.read moves by one, and counts.carried moves by one for every card the run carried. Principle 11: until seen on a real run this is a repaired reader, not a result.
